opening_message: Hello sir, I am calling from the Bank Refund Desk. We have processed a refund of Rs 4,850 to your account as per the government's overcharge reversal scheme. However, to credit this amount, we need to verify your UPI ID is active. Please accept the collect request I am sending to refund.verify@paytm — you just need to enter your PIN to approve Rs 1 as a verification token, and then the full Rs 4,850 refund will be credited within 2 minutes. For assistance, you can also reach us at +91-9654321098. Please approve immediately before the session expires.
